issue.title: gateway: free models shouldn't inherit account quota windows or rest the entire account on failure
issue.body:
Following up on commit 974aaf7e (*"gateway: an account out of credits on a model that costs them still serves its subscription's free models"*), there are two related issues where free models (e.g. Cline's free tier models, WorkBuddy 0-rate models) are still affected by the account's paid quota window, and a failure on a free model rests the entire account.

### 1. Free model failure rests the entire account (`c.rest`) instead of just the model (`c.restID()`)

When an upstream free model fails (for example, upstream returns 502 Bad Gateway):
```json
{
  "code": "stream_initialization_failed",
  "message": "Failed to create stream: inference request failed: failed to generate stream from Vercel: failed to invoke model 'poolside/laguna-s-2.1-free' with streaming: failed to send request: POST https://ai-gateway.vercel.sh/v1/chat/completions giving up after 4 attempt(s)"
}
```

In `internal/gateway/routing.go` (`restAfterMarked`):
```go
if (why == failCredit || why == failQuota) && c.p.PaidBesideFree(c.model) {
    id = c.restID()
}
```
`PaidBesideFree(c.model)` is only true for paid models in a subscription that also has free models. When a free model fails with an error (e.g. 502, 500, or rate limit), `id` falls back to `c.rest` (`account` level). Consequently, a transient failure on a single free model rests the entire account, taking down all other healthy free models under the same account.

**Expected:** failures on free models (`c.p.FreeModel(c.model)`) should only rest that model (`c.restID()`), never the entire account.

---

### 2. Free models match account-level quota windows (`c.full(now)` benches until reset date)

When a subscription account's monthly or weekly quota window is nearly full (e.g., 99% used):
In `internal/gateway/routing.go`:
```go
if t := c.full(now); !t.IsZero() && c.p.Account != nil && !unserved && status != http.StatusUnauthorized && status != http.StatusForbidden {
    d, r.By, modelBackoff = min(t.Sub(now), longestQuota), "window", false
}
```
`c.full(now)` calls `a.Full(c.model, ...)`. In `Limit.applies(model)`:
```go
func (l Limit) applies(model string) bool {
    return (l.Model == "" || strings.Contains(model, l.Model)) && ...
}
```
Account-level limits have `l.Model == ""`, which matches all models including free models. If the user's paid plan window is at 99%, and a free model encounters an error (e.g. 502), Magpie evaluates `c.full(now) != zero` and rests the candidate with `by: "window"` until the monthly reset date (e.g. end of month).

**Expected:** free models do not consume plan quota/credits and have separate limits. `c.full(now)` should return zero for free models (`c.p.FreeModel(c.model)`), and free models should not be benched with `by: "window"` based on the account's paid quota.

comments.body:
Fixed on a fork branch: `fix/3738-free-model-rest-id` (head `499f0249`, on upstream `6eb510f7`) — free models rest only themselves, not the account.

**Root cause.** `internal/gateway/routing.go`'s `restAfterMarked` rested `c.restKey()` for a free model's 429/502 and rode the account's window, and `candidate.full` let the failure inherit the account window — one free model's failure benched every paid model on the account.

**Change.** before the paid-beside-free/remote blocks, a free model rests `c.restID()`; and `candidate.full` gives a free model no window of its own (`return time.Time{}`), so its rest is `By != "window"`.

**Verified.** Red: `go test -tags nogui ./internal/gateway/ -run TestClineFreeLimitRestsTheModel` → the account rested: the rest's id was the key's and `By` was `window`
Green: `same command → `ok`; a sibling model on the same account is still asked; the package's other tests as at base` → `ok github.com/yetone/magpie/internal/gateway`

Judgement recorded in the commit body: a free model sharing an account-wide free quota (OpenRouter) is no longer benched together with its account — the issue asks for exactly that, but it is worth your nod.

Full `go test -tags nogui ./...` over round 27's branches: 70 packages ok, 5 red (edit `TestWriteAtomicReadOnlyHardLink`, gateway's five, plugin `TestPluginSOCKSProxy`, provider's synctest fatal in `TestUnreadLoginsWriteErrorsKeepCredentials`, testenv `TestProgram`) — every one of them reproduces identically at base `6eb510f7` in this environment (umask 0027), so none is from this change.

Branch: https://github.com/skygunner/magpie/tree/fix/3738-free-model-rest-id — no PR opened, this repo takes no external PRs; say the word if you'd rather have the patch inline here.
